arxiv-2106-13797.creator: Wenhai Wang, Enze Xie, Xiang Li, Deng-Ping Fan, Kaitao Song, Ding Liang, Tong Lu, Ping Luo, Ling Shao
arxiv-2106-13797.description: Abstract Transformer recently has presented encouraging progress in computer vision. In this work, we present new baselines by improving the original Pyramid Vision Transformer (PVT v1) by adding three designs, including (1) linear complexity attention layer, (2) overlapping patch embedding, and (3) convolutional feed-forward network.

arxiv-2401-03530.title: Detecting Anomalies in Blockchain Transactions using Machine Learning Classifiers and Explainability Analysis
arxiv-2401-03530.creator: Mohammad Hasan, Mohammad Shahriar Rahman, Helge Janicke, Iqbal H. Sarker
arxiv-2401-03530.description: Abstract As the use of Blockchain for digital payments continues to rise in popularity, it also becomes susceptible to various malicious attacks. Successfully detecting anomalies within Blockchain transactions is essential for bolstering trust in digital payments. However, the task of anomaly detection in Blockchain transaction data is challenging due to the infrequent occurrence of illicit transactions.

arxiv-2403-16310.title: An infinite family of Type 1 fullerene nanodiscs Note: Partially supported by CNPq, FAPERJ and CAPES. Journal: Discrete Applied Mathematics VSI: DAM-GO XI
arxiv-2403-16310.creator: Mariana Cruz, Diane Castonguay, Celina de Figueiredo, Diana Sasaki
arxiv-2403-16310.description: Abstract A total coloring of a graph colors all its elements, vertices and edges, with no adjacency conflicts. The Total Coloring Conjecture (TCC) is a sixty year old challenge, says that every graph admits a total coloring with at most maximum degree plus two colors, and many graph parameters have been studied in connection with its validity.

arxiv-2407-04735.title: Modified Compton Effect and CMB Anisotropy
arxiv-2407-04735.creator: Zahra Davari
arxiv-2407-04735.description: Abstract Recent satellite observations have revealed significant anisotropy in the cosmic microwave background (CMB) radiation, a phenomenon that had previously been detected but received limited attention due to its subtlety. With the advent of more precise measurements from satellites, the extent of this anisotropy has become increasingly apparent.

arxiv-2511-19320.title: SteadyDancer: Harmonized and Coherent Human Image Animation with First-Frame Preservation
arxiv-2511-19320.creator: Jiaming Zhang, Shengming Cao, Rui Li, Xiaotong Zhao, Yutao CuiXinglin Hou, Gangshan Wu, Haolan Chen, Limin Wang, Kai Ma
arxiv-2511-19320.description: Abstract Preserving first-frame identity while ensuring precise motion control is a fundamental challenge in human image animation. The Image-to-Motion Binding process of the dominant Reference-to-Video (R2V) paradigm overlooks critical spatio-temporal misalignments common in real-world applications, leading to failures such as identity drift and visual artifacts.

pmc-11470662.title: Examining concordance of sexual-related factors and PrEP eligibility with HIV risk perception among adolescent girls and young women: cross-sectional insights from DREAMS sites in Kenya, Malawi, and Zambia
pmc-11470662.creator: Craig J Heck, Domonique M Reed, Jerry Okal, Effie Chipeta, Michael Mbizvo, Sanyukta Mathur
pmc-11470662.description: BackgroundHIV risk perception is an important cognition for prevention, theoretically engendering service-seeking and risk-reduction behaviors, but its composition remains poorly understood. We examined country-specific correlates of self-appraised HIV exposure risk among sexually active adolescent girls and young women (AGYW, aged 15–24 years) without HIV in Kenya, Malawi, and Zambia.

pmc-11480333.title: The global phosphorylation landscape of mouse oocytes during meiotic maturation
pmc-11480333.creator: Hongzheng Sun, Longsen Han, Yueshuai Guo, Huiqing An, Bing Wang, Xiangzheng Zhang, Jiashuo Li, Yingtong Jiang, Yue Wang, Guangyi Sun, Shuai Zhu, Shoubin Tang, Juan Ge, Minjian Chen, Xuejiang Guo, Qiang Wang
pmc-11480333.description: Phosphorylation is a key post-translational modification regulating protein function and biological outcomes. However, the phosphorylation dynamics orchestrating mammalian oocyte development remains poorly understood. In the present study, we apply high-resolution mass spectrometry-based phosphoproteomics to obtain the first global in vivo quantification of mouse oocyte phosphorylation.

pmc-11544042.title: Dexmedetomidine preconditioning attenuates ferroptosis in myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury via α2 adrenergic receptor activation
pmc-11544042.creator: Mingling Wang, Zhuoyu Ren, Xiaotong Sun, Yaozu Li, Zuolei Chen
pmc-11544042.description: ObjectiveDexmedetomidine (Dex) is a potent agonist of the α2 adrenergic receptor that has been shown to possess sedative and hypnotic properties. Dex can protect against myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury (MIRI) by inhibiting ferroptosis. However, these studies were based on Dex post-conditioning, and the role of α2 adrenergic receptors in this process is unclear.

pmc-11565111.title: Characterizing PANoptosis gene signature in prognosis and chemosensitivity of colorectal cancer
pmc-11565111.creator: Tingyu Zhao, Xiao Zhang, Xiao Liu, Xingyu Jiang, Silu Chen, Huiqin Li, Hongsheng Ji, Sumeng Wang, Qi Liang, Siqi Ni, Mulong Du, Lingxiang Liu
pmc-11565111.description: BackgroundPANoptosis is a cell death pathway involved in pyroptosis, apoptosis and necrosis, and plays a key role in the development of malignant tumors. However, the molecular signature of PANoptosis in colorectal cancer (CRC) prognosis has not been thoroughly explored. The present study aimed to develop a novel prognostic model based on PANoptosis-related genes in CRC.

pmc-11605686.title: Leveraging genomes to support conservation and bioeconomy policies in a megadiverse country
pmc-11605686.creator: Sibelle Torres Vilaça, Amanda F. Vidal, Ana Carolina D’Oliveira Pavan, Bruno Marques Silva, Carolina S. Carvalho, Cintia Povill, Danielle Luna-Lucena, Gisele L. Nunes, Henrique Vieira Figueiró, Izabela Santos Mendes, Jose Augusto P. Bittencourt, Lara Gomes Côrtes, Lucas Eduardo Costa Canesin, Renato
pmc-11605686.description: SummaryThe biodiversity crisis is a global phenomenon, and measures to monitor, stop, and revert the impacts on species’ extinction risk are urgently needed. Megadiverse countries, especially in the Global South, are responsible for managing and protecting Earth’s biodiversity. Various initiatives have started to sequence reference-level genomes or perform large-scale species detection and monitoring through environmental DNA.

pmc-11609691.title: A deep learning model for predicting the modified micro-dosimetric kinetic model-based dose and the dose-averaged linear energy transfer for prostate cancer in carbon ion therapy
pmc-11609691.creator: Liwen Zhang, Weiwei Wang, Ping Li, Qing Zhang, Rongcheng Han
pmc-11609691.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Highlights•Biological dose and linear energy transfer predictable by deep learning algorithms.•Gamma pass rate above 96% comparing prediction and calculation.•Prediction time of 12 s has potential for application in daily clinical routine.Keywords: Adaptive carbon ion radiotherapy, Deep learning, RBE-weighted dose, Dose-averaged linear energy transfer

Introduction

Carbon ion radiotherapy (CIRT) is known for its superior physical properties and enhanced relative biological effectiveness (RBE), allowing precise targeting with minimal impact on surrounding tissues, making it effective for prostate cancer treatment [1].

pmc-12396358.title: IUC24427-84 Reducing UTI and sepsis after flexible cystoscopy: impact of a protocol-based approach in high-risk patients—outcomes from a high-volume university teaching hospital
pmc-12396358.creator: L Gradwell, A Pietropaolo
pmc-12396358.description: BackgroundFlexible cystoscopy is a common urological procedure, with a low risk of urinary tract infection and sepsis. This risk is greater in high-risk patients. While guidelines don’t recommend antibiotic prophylaxis, we developed a protocol for high-risk patients undergoing flexible cystoscopy in conjunction with the microbiology department (Figure 1).

pmc-12401544.title: Automatic and accurate reconstruction of long-range axonal projections of single-neuron in mouse brain
pmc-12401544.creator: Lin Cai, Taiyu Fan, Xuzhong Qu, Ying Zhang, Xianyu Gou, Quanwei Ding, Weihua Feng, Tingting Cao, Xiaohua Lv, Xiuli Liu, Qing Huang, Tingwei Quan, Shaoqun Zeng, Richard Naud, Lin Cai, Taiyu Fan, Xuzhong Qu, Ying Zhang, Xianyu Gou, Quanwei Ding, Weihua Feng, Tingting Cao, Xiaohua Lv, Xiuli Liu, Qing H
pmc-12401544.description: Single-neuron axonal projections reveal the route map of neuron output and provide a key cue for understanding how information flows across the brain. Reconstruction of single-neuron axonal projections requires intensive manual operations in tens of terabytes of brain imaging data and is highly time-consuming and labor-intensive.

pmc-12716057.title: Association between introduction of 13-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine and burden of hospitalized adult pneumococcal disease in Hong Kong – A retrospective database study
pmc-12716057.creator: Qiuyan Yu, Celine Sze Ling Chui, See-Hwee Yeo, Dony Patel, Cindy Thiow Koon Lim, Xue Li, Vivien Kin Yi Chan, Eriko Yamada, Isaya Sukarom
pmc-12716057.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). There is limited information on the association between burden of pneumococcal disease and vaccination. This study aimed to assess pneumococcal disease burden among adults in Hong Kong by estimating incidence rate (IR), case fatality rate (CFR), healthcare resource utilization and costs before and after the introduction of 13-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV13) into Hong Kong’s childhood immunization program (CIP) in 2011.

pmc-12742294.title: Clinical Efficacy of Endoscopy-Assisted Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion for Single-Segment Cervical Spondylotic Myelopathy: A Retrospective, Propensity Score-Matched Study
pmc-12742294.creator: Tusheng Li, Jingbo Ma, Hanshuo Zhang, Qiang Jiang, Yu Ding
pmc-12742294.description: PurposeEndoscopy-assisted anterior cervical discectomy and fusion (EA-ACDF), which integrates the advantages of conventional ACDF and spinal endoscopy, is an innovative technique for treating cervical spondylotic myelopathy (CSM). We compared the clinical efficacy of EA-ACDF and ACDF for treating patients with single-segment CSM.

pmc-12978154.title: A Rare and Delayed Presentation of Retinoblastoma in an 8-Year-Old Child: A Case Report
pmc-12978154.creator: Ahmed Almaweri
pmc-12978154.description: IntroductionRetinoblastoma is the most common primary intraocular malignancy in childhood and is typically diagnosed prior to the age of five. Late presentation beyond this age is uncommon and is often associated with delayed recognition, misdiagnosis, or restricted access to specialized eye centers.

pmc-13071577.title: Preparation and characterization of layered double hydroxide (LDH) films with varying divalent cation species on Al–Si–Cu alloys by steam coating
pmc-13071577.creator: Io Matsui, Yuki Atsuumi, Hikari Ouchi, Kota Fukuhara, Takahiro Ishizaki
pmc-13071577.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Aluminum alloys are widely utilized in various industries due to their excellent mechanical and physical properties. However, the presence of alloying elements like Si and Cu in Al–Si–Cu alloys necessitates surface treatment to mitigate their inherent susceptibility to corrosion. In this study, layered double hydroxide (LDH) films containing different divalent cations—namely, Mg–Al, Co–Al, Ni–Al, and Zn–Al LDH films—were prepared on Al–Si–Cu alloy substrates using the steam coating method to investigate the influence of the cation species on corrosion protection performance.

pmc-13475784.creator: Jun'an Yu, Jun Chen, Anjie Ren, Hui Duan, Hua Meng, Zhuo Gao
pmc-13475784.description: BackgroundGenerative AI chat systems are increasingly used for everyday information seeking, but plausible errors and omissions can mislead users when outputs are accepted without scrutiny. Interface-level safety cues may help users calibrate trust and engage in verification; yet, evidence in older Chinese adults remains limited.
